name: Zscaler — Second C2 Domain Blocked (Web Proxy)
xql_query:
dataset = zscaler_nssweblog_raw
| filter act = "Blocked"
| filter cs1 = "Malicious Content" or cat contains "Malware" or cat contains "Spyware"
       or cat contains "Botnet" or cat contains "Command" or cat contains "Exploit"
| filter src != null and suser != null
| alter src_ip = src, user_name = suser, url = request, dst_ip = dst
description: Zscaler NSS web log Blocked action on a malicious/C2 category — web proxy blocking the second C2 candidate after the first DNS RPZ block. Correlated to the victim by src and suser.
alert_name: Zscaler — Second C2 Domain Blocked (Web Proxy)
